createAccount.question: How do I create an account?
createAccount.answer: Download the OurBride app, click Sign Up, and fill in your details. You can also register using Google, Facebook, or Apple.

resetPassword.question: How do I reset my password?
resetPassword.answer: Go to Settings → Security → Change Password. Enter your old password, then create and confirm your new one.

bookService.question: How do I book a service?
bookService.answer: Browse services, choose a provider, select a date, and click Book Now. You'll receive confirmation once the provider accepts.

cancelReschedule.question: Can I cancel or reschedule a booking?
cancelReschedule.answer: Yes, go to My Bookings, select the booking, and choose Cancel or Reschedule. Please check the provider's cancellation policy first.

trackBooking.question: How do I track my booking request?
trackBooking.answer: Open My Bookings → select your request. You'll see the status: Submitted → Under Review → Confirmed → Payment Due.

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods are accepted?
paymentMethods.answer: We support credit/debit cards, mobile wallets, and bank transfers depending on your region.

applyCoupon.question: How do I apply a coupon?
applyCoupon.answer: At checkout, enter your coupon code in the Apply Coupon field. The discount will be applied automatically.

couponNotWorking.question: Why is my coupon not working?
couponNotWorking.answer: Make sure the coupon hasn't expired, applies to the selected service, and meets the minimum order amount.

providerVerification.question: How are service providers verified?
providerVerification.answer: Every provider must upload valid ID and service documents. Verified providers have a ✅ badge next to their name.

paymentSecurity.question: Are my payments secure?
paymentSecurity.answer: Yes, all transactions are processed through encrypted payment gateways to protect your data.

reportProblem.question: Can I report a problem with a provider?
reportProblem.answer: Yes, go to the provider's profile or your booking details, click Report a Problem, and describe the issue.

about.pageSubtitle: Your trusted partner for creating the perfect wedding experience

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: At OurBride, we believe that every wedding should be a perfect reflection of your unique love story. Our mission is to make wedding planning effortless, enjoyable, and memorable by connecting brides and grooms with the finest wedding products and services.
mission.p2: We are committed to providing a seamless experience where you can discover, compare, and book everything you need for your special day - all in one place.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.p1: We envision a world where wedding planning is stress-free and accessible to everyone. Our platform brings together verified service providers, quality products, and a supportive community to help you create the wedding of your dreams.
vision.p2: Through innovation, trust, and dedication, we aim to be the leading destination for couples planning their perfect day.

trust.title: Trust & Transparency
trust.desc: We verify all service providers and maintain transparent pricing to ensure you make informed decisions.

quality.title: Quality & Excellence
quality.desc: We curate only the best products and services, ensuring high standards and exceptional quality for your special day.

community.title: Community & Support
community.desc: Our vibrant community of brides, grooms, and wedding professionals supports and inspires each other throughout the planning journey.

innovation.title: Innovation & Convenience
innovation.desc: We continuously innovate to make wedding planning easier, faster, and more convenient through technology and user-friendly solutions.

contact.desc: Have questions or feedback? We love to hear from you!

returns.pageSubtitle: Simple and hassle-free return process for your peace of mind

policy.title: Return Policy
policy.introPrefix: We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. If you're not happy with your order, you can return most items within
policy.introSuffix: of delivery for a full refund or exchange.

1.title: Initiate Return
1.p1Suffix: page, select the item you want to return, and click "Request Return".

2.title: Get Return Authorization
2.desc: Once approved, you'll receive a return authorization and shipping label via email.

3.title: Package & Ship
3.desc: Package the item securely with all original packaging and tags, attach the return label, and ship it back to us.

4.title: Receive Refund
4.desc: Once we receive and inspect your return, we'll process your refund to the original payment method within 5-10 business days.

processing.title: Refund Processing Time
processing.desc: Refunds are typically processed within 5-10 business days after we receive your return. The time it takes for the refund to appear in your account depends on your payment method and financial institution.

shippingCosts.title: Shipping Costs
shippingCosts.desc: Original shipping costs are non-refundable unless the item was defective or we made an error. Return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer unless the return is due to our error.

exchanges.title: Exchanges
exchanges.p1: If you need a different size, color, or style, you can request an exchange during the return process. Exchanges are subject to product availability.
exchanges.p2: If the item you want is not available, we'll process a refund instead.

damaged.title: Damaged or Defective Items
damaged.p1: If you receive a damaged or defective item, please contact us immediately. We'll arrange for a replacement or full refund, including return shipping costs.
damaged.p2: Please take photos of the damaged item and packaging to help us process your claim faster.

contact.title: Need Help with Returns?
contact.desc: If you have questions about returns or need assistance, we're here to help.
